messages.subject: Inla Kumar Error
parts:
Hi, sorry, Im getting an error when I run estimation with kumar family. What could be the problem? :

formula.kumar = y ~ 1
hyper.family = list(theta = list(prior="loggamma", param=c(1, 0.01),fixed=FALSE))
control.family1 = list(control.link=list(quantile = 0.5),hyper =  hyper.family)
fit.kumar = inla(formula.kumar
                ,data = datos
                ,family = "qkumar"
                ,control.family = control.family1
                ,verbose = TRUE
                ,control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE)
                ,control.compute= list(config=TRUE,waic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE)
                )
